scenicChapters.title: Enryaku-ji → Nara Palace Site
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 57 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-enryaku-ji-pilgrimage-routes-kuma.story: A 345 km round trip from Ōtsu - roughly 5 h 57 in the saddle. The stops in between: Nara Palace Site, Kengoshizuka Mounded Tomb, Yoshino and Ômine - Ôminesan-ji and Pilgrimage Routes - Kumano Sankeimichi - K. The highest point is about 800 m. The line favours views over speed.
